industrial_colonies:planetary/desh/feed_: Desh processing: Crushes the raw planetary feed into grit, the first custom processing intermediate. Grit is not usable refined metal; it feeds enrichment.
industrial_colonies:planetary/desh/grit_: Desh processing: Enriches grit into concentrate using Mekanism. This intermediate then enters the Chemical Vat; it is not a machine or finished ingot.
industrial_colonies:planetary/desh/conce: Desh processing: Chemically treats enriched concentrate in a TFMG Chemical Vat. The leached compound is a custom intermediate for the next reduction stage, not a standalone usable item.
industrial_colonies:planetary/desh/leach: Desh processing: Reduces the leached compound into useful planetary metal. This completes the custom refining chain before later plates and machinery. Judge its process cost across the full grit -> concentrate -> leaching -> reduction route.

industrial_colonies:mekanism_components/: A component for the Electrolytic Separator, not a usable machine by itself. The separator splits fluids into chemicals, including water into hydrogen and oxygen. The core's electrodes, insulation and coil represent the internal electrochemical stack. Judge it as a manufactured component, rather than a complete machine.
industrial_colonies:create_addons/experi: Experience-handling utility from Create Enchantment Industry. It collects experience into the mod's liquid-experience system. Its role is experience logistics, not general item production. That makes restoring the default recipe a reasonable choice under your utility policy; an expensive electronics gate is a design choice, not required by its function.
industrial_colonies:mekanism_tools/armor: Wearable powered footwear: Free Runners provide step assistance and spend energy to protect against falls; the armored version adds protection. This is mobility equipment, not manufacturing infrastructure. Review its price against exploration equipment rather than factory machines.
industrial_colonies:outer_station/atmosp: Custom late-game gas extraction block. On a commissioned station inside the gas-giant extraction region, it consumes 8,192 FE/t and 4 mB/t of TFMG cooling fluid. A continuous 400-tick cycle produces 1,000 mB of gas-giant condensate. It stops without station services, coolant, power, or output space. This is functional machinery for the warp-material supply chain.
industrial_colonies:outer_station/statio: Custom ship/station service controller. It requires sustained power, TFMG coolant and oxygen coverage to commission the vessel after 600 ticks. Current controller use is 4,096 FE/t and 1 mB/t coolant. Loss of required services prevents commissioning. It provides operating authority for station extraction and the later travel systems; it is a functional controller block.
industrial_colonies:interstellar/navigat: Custom final-stage navigation block. It authorizes the configured Sol-to-Glacio route for the warp system, rather than providing unrestricted teleportation. A commissioned ship, drive, route crystal, physical warp charge and safety conditions are still needed. Its cost should reflect late-game navigation/control electronics.
industrial_colonies:planetary/navigation: Custom onboard route computer required for Mars descent. It is a physical ship component, not a research token. Manufacturing it uses the preceding planetary supply chain so visiting later destinations requires offworld industry.
industrial_colonies:planetary/venus/navi: Custom onboard route computer for Venus descent. It also satisfies the earlier Mars navigation check, but does not remove Venus heat-protection requirements. Treat this as upgraded navigation hardware.
industrial_colonies:planetary/mercury/na: Custom onboard route computer for Mercury descent. It also satisfies earlier navigation checks; environmental protection requirements still apply. This belongs after the earlier planetary material chains.
industrial_colonies:space/construction/c: Construction document for the Physics Assembler route. The custom certified plans represent completed propulsion and guidance manufacturing checks. They are intermediate components, not placeable machines. Review the plan ingredients as technical certification stages rather than literal spacecraft blocks.
industrial_colonies:space/construction/g: Custom intermediate construction plan produced by guidance certification. It represents a manufactured and checked navigation system; the certification route preserves its reference hardware using Keep Held Item. The plan feeds the spacecraft construction chain and has no standalone machine function.
industrial_colonies:space/construction/p: Custom intermediate construction plan produced by propulsion certification. Its reference hardware is retained by Keep Held Item. The resulting document feeds spacecraft construction; it is not an engine or a placeable machine.
industrial_colonies:world_loading/dimens: Mekanism's powered chunk-loading machine. Its name does not mean it creates dimensions or stabilizes a portal. Spatial/control materials can express its function, but the recipe should represent powered chunk management. Your request for more relevant ingredients remains design feedback; this explanation does not mean a redesign has already been applied.
